what: Over a labeled panel, a frosted-glass circle 11rem in diameter (10px backdrop blur) turns on from 0 → 1x scale in .1s showing its name (like ‹Browse›), and trails the mouse by .15 of the remaining distance each frame. It turns off in .1s over button·link circles or when leaving the panel.

options.text: Text shown on the circle, default ”View” (data-fx-blur-label-cursor="text: Browse")
options.look: fade: Shape that changes only opacity without growing (Brand PLAY MOVIE)
options.size: Circle diameter (CSS length), default --fx-size or 11rem — Brand 16.2rem
options.--fx-glass: Circle background (CSS variable, in :root), default is the stage color at 60% of the contrast color — the Brand theme uses the contrast text color at 10% (bright glass)
options.look: pop: Shape that scales to 1x in .25s when turning on, and shrinks to .8x in .2s while vanishing when turning off (power2.out) — Brand GO WORK button

note: One circle is made per document and shared by all panels. Color is --kf-contrast-bg 60% glass + --kf-contrast-ink text. Not applied below 992 width or on devices without hover
